test_cases.tc_title: No Supported Files Found shows PU0003
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. USB device with no supported files connected.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Select the USB source.
2. Read the popup displayed.
3. Check that the popup ID is PU0003.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. PU0003 popup is displayed.
test_cases.test_item: When No Supported Files Found Error occurs the HU shall display Pop Up ID PU0003.

test_cases.tc_title: USB File Read Error shows PU0024
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. USB device that triggers a file read error.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Play a file that causes a read error.
2. Read the popup displayed.
3. Check that the popup ID is PU0024.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. PU0024 popup is displayed.
test_cases.test_item: When USB Device File Read Error occurs the HU shall display Pop Up ID PU0024.

test_cases.tc_title: Generic error shows PU0005
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. An error condition not mapped to PU0003/PU0024.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Trigger an uncovered error.
2. Read the popup displayed.
3. Check that the popup ID is PU0005.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. PU0005 (Generic Error) popup is displayed.
test_cases.test_item: The HU shall treat any error not covered above as a Generic Error and display PU0005.

test_cases.tc_title: AUX source has no command controls

test_cases.expected_result: 1. Only Source and Audio tabs are available; other play controls are greyed out.

test_cases.tc_title: Skip Forward completes to next file
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Let Skip Forward find the next file.
2. Read the playback state and position.
3. Check that the new file plays from its beginning.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The new file plays from the beginning in Play mode.
test_cases.test_item: On finding the next file the HU shall exit Skip Forward, return to Play mode and play the new file from its beginning.

test_cases.tc_title: BTSA Skip Back function controllable

2. Read the now-playing position.
3. Check that playback moved per the Skip Back rule.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. Playback skips back per the Skip Back behaviour.
test_cases.test_item: The HU shall be able to control the BTSA device with a Skip Back function.

test_cases.tc_title: Skip Back completes and plays file
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Let Skip Back find the target file.
2. Read the playback state and position.
3. Check that the file plays from its beginning.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The target file plays from the beginning in Play mode.
test_cases.test_item: On finding the current/previous file the HU shall exit Skip Back, return to Play mode and play from the beginning.

test_cases.tc_title: Skip Back within 3 sec restarts current
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. Current track playing for less than 3 sec.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Invoke Skip Back.
2. Read the now-playing track and position.
3. Check that the current track restarts from its beginning.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The current track restarts from the beginning.
test_cases.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
test_cases.test_item: Within 3 sec from the beginning, Skip Back shall return to and play the current file from its beginning.

test_cases.tc_title: Skip Back after 3 sec goes to previous
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. Current track playing for more than 3 sec.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Invoke Skip Back.
2. Read the now-playing track and position.
3. Check that the previous track plays from its beginning.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The previous track plays from the beginning.
test_cases.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
test_cases.test_item: After 3 sec from the beginning, Skip Back shall play the previous file from its beginning.

test_cases.test_item: The system shall support Browsing Metadata via the Browse Tab.

test_cases.tc_title: Browse displays Categories/Folders list
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Select the Browse function.
2. Check that a list of Categories/Folders is displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. A list of browse Categories/Folders is displayed.
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
test_cases.test_item: When the user selects Browse the HU shall display a list of browse Categories/Folders.

test_cases.tc_title: Screen Return/Close exits Browse
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Select the Screen Return/Close function.
2. Check that the Browse screen is closed and the previous screen is shown.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The Browse screen closes and the previous screen is displayed.
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
test_cases.test_item: On the Browse screen the Screen Return/Close function shall request the HU to return/close.

test_cases.tc_title: Scroll Up and Down move one row
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Select Scroll Down.
2. Read the list position.
3. Select Scroll Up.
4. Check that the list moved one row down then one row up.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The list scrolls one row down, then one row up.
test_cases.test_item: When the user selects Scroll Up or Down the HU shall update the display one row at a time.

test_cases.tc_title: Page Up and Down move one page
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Select Page Down.
2. Read the list page.
3. Select Page Up.
4. Check that the list moved one page down then one page up.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The list pages down one page, then up one page.
test_cases.test_item: When the user selects Page Up or Down the HU shall update the display one page of items.

test_cases.tc_title: Showroom Demo Video loads and plays
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. Dealer Mode with an uploaded Demo Video.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Select a Showroom Demo Video.
2. Read the playback state and output.
3. Check that the video loads and plays with audio/video output.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The Demo Video loads and plays with audio and video output.
test_cases.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
test_cases.test_item: The HU shall load and play the Showroom Demo Video in Dealer Mode (CFTS012 DEAL-026).

test_cases.tc_title: App Tray shows 3rd party service shortcut
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Open the App Tray.
2. Read the displayed shortcuts.
3. Check that the 3rd party service shortcut is shown.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The 3rd party service shortcut is displayed in the App Tray.
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
test_cases.test_item: The App Tray shall display shortcuts for 3rd party services.

test_cases.tc_title: App Store opens template app
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. App Store open with Weather/POI templated apps.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Select the Weather app.
2. Check that the Weather template app opens.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The Weather template app opens.
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
test_cases.test_item: The App Store shall bring the template for Weather and POI apps when selected.

test_cases.tc_title: Enabling app shows its icon
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. A templated service app, currently disabled.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Enable the templated app.
2. Open the App drawer.
3. Check that the app icon appears.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The app icon appears in the App drawer.
test_cases.test_item: When the user enables a templated service app the App Icon shall appear in the App drawer.

test_cases.tc_title: Disabling app removes its icon
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. A templated service app, currently enabled with icon shown.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Disable the templated app.
2. Open the App drawer.
3. Check that the app icon is removed from all pages.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The app icon is removed from the App drawer.
test_cases.test_item: When the user disables a templated service app the App Icon shall be removed from the App drawer.

test_cases.tc_title: App Tray shows installed app launch icon
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Open the App Tray.
2. Check that a standard launch icon for the app is displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. A standard launch icon for the installed app is displayed.
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
test_cases.test_item: The App Tray shall display a standard launch icon for a 3rd party Android app after install.

test_cases.tc_title: App icon launches default activity
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. A 3rd party app installed with an icon.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Select the app icon.
2. Read the launched screen.
3. Check that the app's default activity launches.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The app's default activity launches.
test_cases.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
test_cases.test_item: The app icon shall launch the app's default activity when selected.

test_cases.tc_title: Unauthenticated source shows Login menu
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. A media source whose AAM reports not logged in.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Select the media source.
2. Read the displayed screen.
3. Check that the Login menu is presented.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The Login menu is presented.
test_cases.test_item: When a selected media source is not logged in the HU shall present the Login menu.

test_cases.tc_title: Settings button shown only when supported
test_cases.pre_conditions: 1. One app that supports settings and one that does not.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Open the app that supports settings.
2. Check that the settings button is shown.
3. Open the app without settings support.
4. Check that the settings button is not shown.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. Settings button shown for the supporting app; not shown for the non-supporting app.
test_cases.test_item: The HU shall show the settings button only if the app supports the settings interface.

test_cases.tc_title: Login uses Android P flows and failure UI
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Start the login flow.
2. Enter invalid credentials.
3. Read the response.
4. Check that the authentication-failure interface is shown.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The login flow runs and the authentication-failure interface is shown on invalid credentials.
test_cases.test_item: The HU shall use the Android P login flows and authentication-failure interfaces.
